product_metadata.title: rocboc 10 Liter/12 Can Mini Fridge for Bedroom, Rapid Cooling Skincare Fridge for Cosmetics, Foods, Breast Milk and Drinks, Mini Refrigerator with AC/DC for Office and Car Cooler Warmer
features: 🍹🍹【High Efficiency Rapid Refrigeration】The mini fridge uses new generation dual-core chip and has a powerful dual system of cooling and heating, use it as an extra storage space for skincare, food, drinks, breast milk, wine, insulin, medications and other essentials. (For maximum cooling, please ensure the mini fridge is standing and its back is at least 3 inches away from a wall).

🍹🍹【Portable Size &10L Capacity】Inner dimensions of 10 liter mini fridge is 6.3”x 7.3”x 11”, chills 12 12 oz soda cans. It comes with three removable shelves, one container basket and built-in with convenient carry handle which makes it easy to take with you on the go!

🍹🍹【Cooling & Heating Dual Modes】This mini fridge for bedroom can make cool up to 45°F (25°C) below ambient temperature or rise to the highest temperature about 149℉(65℃). Enjoy cool coke in summer and hot coffee in winter is such a wonderful thing.

🍹🍹【Super Quiet Operation】The skincare fridge adopts eddy current noise reduction design, less than 28 dB during operation, quiet enough to put it at the bedside, convenient for mothers who need to breastfeeding hungry baby at night.

🍹🍹【Car and Home Use (AC/DC)】Come with AC and DC power cords for indoor or outdoor use. The small fridge has passed ETL certification and is durable. 100% Freon-free safe refrigeration mode, environmentally friendly, can be safely use in your home, bedroom, office, dorm, car, camping and parties.
